correctness.rationale: The generator, killed Green kernel, one-power integrals and temporal-ordering formula were reconstructed. For beta>max(p,q), the mixed expectation is a positive constant times E[Z_{p+q}], giving the exact beta>p+q threshold; the other beta regimes diverge by nonnegative Tonelli. Algebra yields the stated covariance, variance and monotone Pearson formula. Independent quadrature against the Green kernel passed 248 deterministic checks; finite tests were not treated as infinite proofs.
